title: The Mint Instax Teen Girl Christmas Gift Guide
description: A pastel teen girl Christmas gift guide from Walmart: the mint green Instax Mini 12 camera, a lilac floral Instax photo album, a Cotton Candy Sky Owala FreeSip bottle, the Bubble Grand Slam skincare set and a 12-pack of pastel Scunci scrunchies.
intro: Shopping for a teenager is a trap. Ask what she wants and you get a shrug and "I dunno, money?" So this list skips the guessing. A mint Instax Mini 12 so she can print the pictures she'd normally bury in her camera roll, a lilac album to keep them in, the Owala everybody's carrying to school, a Bubble skincare set made for teen skin, and a 12-pack of pastel scrunchies because those disappear faster than socks. Cute, useful, and nothing she'll shove in a drawer.

sections.heading: The photo gifts
paragraphs: The FUJIFILM INSTAX MINI 12 instant film camera in Mint Green, and the Fujifilm instax Mini Purple Floral Album to hold the prints.

sections.heading: The everyday extras
paragraphs: The Owala FreeSip 24 oz stainless steel bottle in Cotton Candy Sky, the Bubble Grand Slam 3-step bestsellers skincare set, and the Scunci Original Scrunchie 12-count pack in pastel multicolor.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The bedroom, the kitchen and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item and color before you buy. Instant film is sold separately.
